per_item.argument: Define the determinant line as the top exterior power of each projector range and its ambient projector as the induced top exterior map; the complete smooth rank-one orthogonal-projection verification is the local lemma.

Use the signed-minor matrix formula to prove the adjoint identity, exterior functoriality for idempotence, and the increasing-wedge basis for the one-dimensional range; prove smoothness from polynomial minors.

note: The batch's sign conventions were recomputed locally. Tong uses the Berry connection -i⟨u|∂u⟩ in the inspected discussion; a spin-half display omits a factor 1/2 and nearby signs are inconsistent, so no sign or factor is copied from it. Xiao–Chang–Niu derive anomalous velocity within a wave-packet approximation; the local velocity theorem claims only the exact Euler–Lagrange consequence of the explicitly adopted effective Lagrangian.
